## Part A Arithmetic Operations
## 01

```{r}
b <- 5
a + b 
a - b
a * b
a / b
```

```{r}
## 02 Division

b <- 5
a %% b

```

```{r}
## 03 Power
```


## Part B Basic Types
```{r}
##01
x <- 42
y <- 42L        # the L suffix forces an integer
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i     # complex number

typeof(x)
typeof(y)
typeof(z)
typeof(v)
```


```{r}
## 02
x <- 42
y <- 42L
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i 

class(x)
class(y)
class(z)
class(w)
class(v)
```

```{r}
x <- 42
y <- 42L
z <- "42"
w <- TRUE
v <- 3 + 2i 

mode(x)
mode(y)
mode(z)
mode(w)
mode(v)
```

```{r}
## Question 3:
x <- 42
y <- 42L

typeof(x)
typeof(y)

## typeof(x) the output is double because in R 42 is double while typeof(y) integer because L is Suffix that force integers to storage.
```
